goal: Attack the proposed white-canvas proper-tower direction from independent visual-systems and semantic-accessibility methodologies, then return verified plan constraints without editing product files.

The operator wants a white canvas and a proper vertical tower. Review the exact current page, manifest, tests, Tower System view, prior Refine result, and foundation findings; return source-cited constraints that the parent can synthesize into a non-executed plan.

agents.angle: spatial composition, architectural legibility, and responsive hierarchy
